data.title: Robotic lab sets up and runs optics experiments on demand
data.description: The process of building and running an optics experiment to analyze a material’s properties could one day be fully automated, MIT scientists say. Taking a step toward such a future, they developed a reconfigurable, robotic optics laboratory.
data.site_name: MIT News | Massachusetts Institute of Technology
